purpose: Preregister the authoritative source-access path for the next prospective monetary driver check and its conditionally admissible MIR response without rewriting the frozen confirmation contract, treating media/social discovery links as canonical evidence, guessing a future BNR decision URL, or inspecting reserved response values.

authoritative_driver_access.event_day_capture_rule: After the scheduled 2026-10-08 meeting, identify the exact BNR monetary-policy decision communiqué from the official BNR decision-release surface. Record the exact official communiqué URL, decision date, policy rate before/after, direction and effective timing before classifying the driver event.

semantic_identity.reference_sector: Deposit-taking corporations except the central bank (S.122)
semantic_identity.balance_sheet_item: Lending for house purchase excluding revolving loans and overdrafts, convenience and extended credit card debt
semantic_identity.rate_type: Annualised agreed rate (AAR) / Narrowly defined effective rate (NDER)
semantic_identity.counterpart_sector: Households and non-profit institutions serving households (S.14 and S.15)

authoritative_response_access.response_access_rule: If and only if October 2026 contains a non-zero BNR policy-rate event, the October-reference MIR observation remains inaccessible until the official scheduled 2026-12-02 release. If the BNR decision is unchanged, no reserved MIR value is opened.

event_day_protocol.step_1: Check the official BNR decision communiqué after the scheduled meeting.
event_day_protocol.step_2: Classify policy-rate change as zero or non-zero using the official decision only.
event_day_protocol.step_3_if_zero: Record unchanged driver status only; keep all reserved MIR response values closed and remain in baseline hold.
event_day_protocol.step_3_if_nonzero: Record event date, sign and magnitude; open only the driver-side Stage 1 diagnostic state. Do not inspect response values before the official same-month MIR release.
event_day_protocol.step_4_after_response_release: At/after the applicable ECB MIR release date, access only the exact frozen MIR series and the minimum event/prior-month observations authorized by the frozen contract.
